transcript.text: indesit oven stoped heating, fan goes round n light on but its stone cold after 20 mins. grill werks fine tho. any ideas b4 i call some1 out

Since the fan runs and the grill works but the main oven stays cold, this usually points to either a control setting preventing heat or a failed heating element. First, please check if your clock is flashing or set to an automatic mode; many Indesit ovens will not heat until you select 'manual' (often a hand symbol) after a power cut or when the time is set. If it is already in manual mode and showing the correct time, then the fan oven element itself has likely failed and needs replacing by an engineer.
yep its in manual, time is set n nothing flashing. heard a little pop from inside near the back last time it worked tho

That 'pop' is the smoking gun—it almost probably means the fan oven heating element has blown internally. Since the grill works and you are in manual mode, the power supply to that specific circuit is fine; the element itself has likely gone open-circuit (broken wire inside), which stops it from heating even though the fan keeps running. This is a standard part replacement by an engineer. You can safely leave it as is for now, but do not try to replace the element yourself unless you are qualified to work on live mains wiring and dismantle the oven cavity safely. Please call out an appliance engineer to fit a new fan oven heating element.

candidates: Control set to manual mode / clock issue (high)
Wiring or connection fault to the element (low)
